# Local history

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Records, history, and messages · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

src/core/history.ts (isomorphic-git, append-only restore), main.ts `historyView` (search, dates, action chips with counts), src/server/activity.ts, settings history

## What is missing

diff view, labels, prune; settings history is a 200-entry localStorage list, not Git; password-protected secret/display-name mutation history; Deploy app history panel parity
